§9YELLOWCAKE IS NOT FUEL. IT IS 0.7% OF THE RIGHT ISOTOPE.§r
Fluorinate it into a gas, spin the gas, keep the light fraction. This is the only way anyone has ever enriched uranium at scale, and it is the only part of this chain that needs a machine GTNH did not already have.

§5F-09 / F-10 CONVERSION§r §8- Chemical Plant t3, IV§r
 §2 4x Yellowcake + 4,000 L Hydrofluoric Acid + 1,000 L Hydrogen  ->  6,000 L Uranium Tetrafluoride + 2,000 L Steam§r
 §2 6,000 L UF4 + 2,000 L Fluorine  ->  6,000 L Uranium Hexafluoride§r

[note]§1Those two fluids are GT++'s OWN materials, not ours.§r If you already run an LFTR line, its uranium hexafluoride feeds straight into the Cascade Hall below - and our UF4/UF6 feed straight into the LFTR chain. Two routes to the same fluid, from ore instead of from metal. Nothing of GT++'s was edited.[/note]

§5F-11 THE CASCADE HALL§r §8- new multiblock, MTE 28113, IV, 60 s§r
 §2 6,000 L UF6 + circuit 1  ->  1,000 L Enriched UF6 + 5,000 L Tails§r
One sixth leaves enriched. Five sixths leave as tails - §9and the tails are a product, not waste§r.

§5WHAT THE TAILS ARE FOR§r
 §2 5,000 L Tails + 8x Calcium Dust  ->  4x Depleted Uranium Ingot + 8x Fluorspar§r §8(Neutron Activator, LuV)§r
 §2 5,000 L Tails + Hydrogen + Water  ->  20x Depleted UO2 Powder§r §8(F-20 - the MOX diluent)§r
The ingots are shielding: §9M-03b§r on the Site Batching Plant spends§2 8 of them per 8 Tungstensteel Reinforced Blocks§r. That is a deliberate interlock - §1your fuel line feeds your casing line§r.

§5F-11b THE HEU BRANCH§r §8- Cascade Hall, circuit 2, LuV, 90 s§r
 §2 1,000 L Enriched UF6 + circuit 2  ->  200 L Highly Enriched UF6 + 800 L Tails§r
  §8Four fifths of the enriched cut, spent to make one fifth of something hotter. Only the naquadah fuel grade ever wants it.§r

[note]The Hall's parallel comes from its §9stage banks§r: each bank doubles it, so the structure sets the throughput rather than a casing tier alone. The circuit picks the assay.[/note]

[warn]A half-built bank does not quietly pass. The Hall counts its casings per bank and restores the count when a bank fails, so a wall with a hole in it fails the structure check instead of forming at the wrong size.[/warn]
